summary: In the sewer main, Neo begins to drown as he is carried along in the flow of waste. He is suddenly snatched from that flow, and a metallic cable lifts him, pulling him up into the belly of a futuristic flying machine that is hovering inside the sewer main.

what_changes.before: Drowning in the flow of waste
what_changes.after: Snatched from the flow and lifted up into the flying machine
what_changes.evidence: Neo begins to drown when he is suddenly snatched from the flow of waste.

what_changes.before: In the flow of waste in the sewer main
what_changes.after: Pulled up into the belly of the hovering flying machine
what_changes.evidence: The metallic cable then lifts, pulling him up into the belly of the futuristic flying machine hovering inside the sewer main.

event_hint.one_line: Neo is pulled from the drowning flow of the sewer into a hovering flying machine.

uncertain: Who operates the flying machine or the cable
Whether the rescue is friendly or hostile
Neo's state after being pulled aboard
